prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” AI video ad maker — the right tool depends on what you need (style, budget, volume, platforms, languages, assets). Below are top options (strong points and when to pick each), plus a quick selection checklist and next steps.

Top picks (as of mid‑2024)
- Synthesia — Best for talking‑head ads with realistic AI presenters and fast localization into many languages. Good for product demos, testimonials, or spokesperson-style ads without hiring actors.
- HeyGen / Movio — Similar to Synthesia; fast avatar-driven ads, often cheaper or with different templates/voices. Good if you want multiple presenters/styles.
- Pictory — Great for turning blog posts/long videos into short social ad clips automatically. Good for repurposing content at scale.
- Canva / InVideo — Template-driven, easy drag‑and‑drop editors with AI text-to-video features. Best for marketers who need speed + design control for social ads.
- Runway — Strong for creative, generative visuals and advanced video editing (AI background removal, image-to-video). Pick if you want novel, attention-grabbing visuals.
- Descript — Excellent for fast edits, overdubs (voice cloning), and repurposing long video into multiple short ads. Great for creators who edit a lot of recorded footage.
- Vyond / Animaker — Best for animated, explainer-style ads and brandable characters.
- Lumen5 / Designs.ai — Good for turning scripts/articles into quick visual ads with automatic scene suggestions.

How to choose
- Style: Avatar/talking head → Synthesia/HeyGen. Animated → Vyond/Animaker. Repurposing long content → Pictory/Descript. Creative visuals → Runway.
- Volume & cost: Template tools (Canva, InVideo, Pictory) tend to be cheaper for many small ads; avatar tools and Runway can be pricier per asset.
- Platform: For vertical short-form (TikTok/Reels), pick tools with vertical templates and fast export presets (Canva, InVideo, Pictory).
- Localization: Synthesia and HeyGen support many languages and lip-synced avatars.
- Control vs speed: Template tools = fast + less custom; Runway/Descript = more creative control + editing power.

Practical recommendation
1. Define one sample ad (message, length, platform).
2. Pick 2 tools to trial (one avatar/template and one creative/repurposing tool).
3. Produce 2–3 variants and A/B test performance (CTR, CVR, CPT).
4. Scale with the tool that gives the best ROAS and workflow.

If you tell me: your budget, ad style (avatar, live-action, animated), platforms (TikTok, IG, YouTube), and whether you have existing assets, I’ll recommend the single best tool for your exact needs and an example workflow to create a high-performing ad.
